design: Pack one byte per author-decoded label. Pin the trace member, chunk digests and starting-window indices in a manifest. Save the six source questions' observations as ordered fixed-width index and label records. Prepare the store before replaying the 154 shifted-window queries in a separate invocation. For each query and policy, reopen its payload files with an empty in-process chunk cache.

policies.cold: Read and hash-check source chunks as needed. Start without saved observations.
policies.rechecked: Read the saved sample file and verify each retained sample against lazily loaded source chunks before seeding the new windows.
policies.pinned: Check the saved sample file against its trusted preparation receipt hash before seeding new windows. Verify any newly requested source chunks.

work: Count requested payload bytes and chunk read calls from the chunk file and saved sample payloads. Record manifest and receipt overhead separately. This is logical file I/O with no requirement to evict the OS page cache. Compare every result against the saved independent shifted-window counts.
